name: Balere

facts.text: World's End holds three octonoid mothers on its shore, each spawning young octonoids: Balere, Mollunero and Zytka.
Balere: level 65, 30,000 health, seven or eight young octonoids, a tether of 2,600.

story: Balere is the eldest of the three octonoid mothers of the World's End shore, and the Sylvan fishers say the shallows belong to her by right of age. She lies half in the water and half on the rocks, a great soft bulk with arms like ships' cables, and her young cling all around her. Disturb her and they come off her in a wave, seven or eight at a time, curling over the rocks toward whoever was foolish enough. She will not follow far. She never needs to: the tide comes back, and so do her children.
legend: Kill the young first or hold them: seven or eight come at once and they bite. AoE helps. She walks home if you drag her up the beach, so fight her by the water. Watch for her sisters down the shore.

aggro: The eldest mother rises from the shallows.

phases.text: Her young slide off her and curl toward you.

lairEntry: The shallows are full of soft, curling shapes.

phases.text: Balere's brood pours over the rocks!
